title: Run the complete test portfolio in continuous integration

events.title: Run the complete test portfolio in continuous integration
events.body:
## Outcome

Make the normal repository workflow run every maintained test family with declared dependencies and clear failure ownership.

## Implementation

- Update `.forkmesh/ci.yml` to run the full worker test suite, tools tests, non-GUI desktop tests, window tests in an isolated offscreen job, and performance-budget tests.
- Declare the tools' cryptography dependency in checked-in development metadata instead of relying on a workstation install.
- Build test binaries before execution so stale local artifacts cannot produce a false pass.
- Add per-job timeouts, deterministic temporary directories, and bounded test artifacts for failed jobs.
- Document the exact local commands represented by each job.

## Acceptance criteria

- A clean environment collects and runs every listed suite without missing-module errors.
- Changing a maintained test to fail makes the corresponding workflow fail.
- Window and performance jobs cannot hang the rest of the workflow indefinitely.
- Local contributor commands and workflow commands match.
- No job requires a live external service or personal credential.

## Dependencies

None.

## Verification

Run the workflow commands from a clean dependency environment and compare collected test counts with the repository's discovered test files and desktop test targets.
